title: California holidays for computing time: Code of Civil Procedure sections 12b and 135, Government Code section 6700
citation: Cal. Code Civ. Proc. §§ 12b, 135; Cal. Gov. Code § 6700
role_note: The Office of Legislative Counsel's own codified text, from its official bulk export; the plain-text conversion is Legalese's and unofficial. Deposited because Code Civ.
